identity.goal: Keep the department aligned with its goal, done-when condition, rules and authority boundary
identity.task: J2.a charter, J2.d rulings, J2.h workable?
constraints: invent a new goal or rule
rewrite a proposal to make it acceptable
ask the CEO merely because agents disagree

adaptation.goal: Read the current state, compare it with the charter's goal and propose the smallest useful workflow or change that reduces the gap
constraints: hide a capability or permission dependency
expand scope to make your proposal appear more valuable

priority.goal: Decide whether a proposal deserves resources now and define the envelope inside which it may operate
constraints: say which accepted workflow runs first
reject a proposal because you dislike its method when it fits the envelope
convert a resource decision into a policy decision

coordination.goal: Decide which registered and funded workflow is ready, what must happen before it, and how simultaneous work avoids collisions
coordination.task: J2.f schedules, holds the write lock
constraints: decide that an expensive workflow is not worthwhile

audit.goal: Evaluate observable results against the charter, workflow completion check, rules and source evidence

identity.goal: the brief becomes a charter that passes the stamp, or the owner is asked what is missing

adaptation.goal: workflows are proposed whose work atoms follow the atom rules

priority.goal: the proposal is priced GRANT, COUNTER or REFUSE with a limit, within the budget left

coordination.goal: registered workflows get an order and named holds

audit.goal: every done-when item has a finding with evidence

check_text.reply-valid: the reply has the shape this function must send
check_text.turn-posted: the turn posted a message or saved a record, to a route this function may use
check_text.charter-stamp: the charter has a statement and at least 3 done-when items that can be checked
check_text.audience-split: the text to the owner names no file, code or agent
check_text.atom-rules: every proposed workflow follows the atom rules
check_text.judge-gate: the plan reaches the confidence gate of 0.80
check_text.price-kept: every granted workflow keeps a price and a money limit
check_text.within-budget: the grant stays within the budget left
check_text.order-registered: only registered workflows are scheduled, each once
check_text.finding-per-item: every done-when item has exactly one finding
check_text.pass-needs-proof: no PASS row is without evidence
check_text.code-measure-wins: what code measured beats what Audit said
